name: Lumia
source:
Yggdrasil Magical Academy First Year
Art Club Member
Class: Medusa

Lumia is a gorgon and first year art club member at Yggdrasil Magical Academy. She wants to be able to draw others, but because of her power to petrify others, she can not stare at people for long. In order to solve her problem, the [url=/c64356]protagonist[/url] uses ero-magic on her!

Ero-magic to use: Petrification resistance and estrus inducing magic!
